accessibility.body_contrast: Bone #EDE4D3 on Inkblack #0B0A08 ≈ 13.5:1; Ash ≈ 6.5:1 for muted; Sulphur ≈ 7:1 for large/UI only
accessibility.focus: 2px Sulphur outline offset 3px on all interactive elements
accessibility.reduced_motion: cover plate reveal disabled; no essential information conveyed by motion alone
validator_checks: no part ink takes an interactive role (Sulphur owns progress/links/focus)
no part ink appears on two different interactive roles in one chapter

chapter_opener_contract.fleurons: small sulphur '·' fleuron at authored paragraph boundaries only; cohort JSON MUST list exact paragraph indices; NEVER modulo/nth-child generated

fragments.apparatus: NB. paragraphs: sulphur (Bloodline in Book II) left margin-bar + mono NB. marker via frozen p.reader-nb hook. Never recolor whole paragraphs.
fragments.sub_notes: (a)/(b)/numbered sub-note paragraphs: slight left indent + part-ink tick in Book III; quiet indent elsewhere

chapter_opener_contract.long_chapters: chapters >120 paragraphs (p3c4, p3c10, p4c15, p5c3): mid-reading relief — one full-width part-motif band at an authored paragraph index (in cohort JSON), art only, never behind text
required_layers: gouged part plate-mark (~120px) per part grammar placement
sulphur rule with fragment-count inscription '<N> FRAGMENTS · <W> WORDS'
Fraunces 900 drop cap on first paragraph (standard chapters)

short_tablet_chapters.composition: title set huge centered, plate-mark above, no drop cap, no fragment inscription

chapter_opener_contract.tablet_spacing_titles: p3c1/p4c1/p5c1 single spaced-title paragraphs are part-title tablets: render centered Fraunces 900, letterspaced, as section monuments

hooks.art_slots: cover plate -> #cover-art via manifest cover.src; chapter plates -> #chapter-art via per-chapter src/class/motif (READER-CONTRACT §3-§4)
hooks.nb: #chapter-text > p.reader-nb (frozen shared classifier, §7; books MUST NOT mint reader-* classes)

chapter_opener_contract.manifest: cohort design/<cohort>.json entries carry src/class/motif per §4 schema; supervisor merges sequentially into design/chapters.json; WtP IDs stable (only IJ provisional)

quiet_variant.rule: Fraunces 700 (not 900), smaller clamp, plate-mark above title — never overlapping the title edge at polemic scale

cover.buttons: quiet ghost buttons; primary Begin Reading in Sulphur-on-Inkblack
cover.composition: left-aligned monumental Fraunces title (THE / WILL TO POWER, clamp(3.5rem,11vw,7rem)); authored ring+hammer gouge plate right 40% desktop / stacked above title on phone; mono eyebrow; sulphur rule; single soft vignette, no gradient washes
cover.eyebrow: FRIEDRICH NIETZSCHE · NOTEBOOKS OF THE 1880s (IBM Plex Mono, tracked)
cover.motion: one plate draw-in reveal ≤900ms; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
cover.slot: #cover-art via manifest cover.src art/cover.svg (declarative; no book JS required)

body.source: Google Fonts variable ital,opsz,wght (reference) or design/fonts/ woff2 (preferred)

loading.primary: book-relative @font-face in design/fonts/ (preferred, ships via build §11)

forbidden: repeated pseudo-element-only restyle of the baseline shell
new illustration media outside the gouge-plate grammar
hotlinked stock or claimed-but-unavailable generated images
part inks used for body prose
editing chapter prose to suit art
sniffing view state from classes (use body[data-view], §2)
identity: The Black Notebook — a posthumous archival object: ink-black paper, bone-white ink, one sulphur-gold accent like a match struck in a dark room. Fragments exhibited as numbered evidence; per-part woodcut-gouge plates.

illustration_medium.method: knockout masks, torn/gouge edges, hatch texture; tinted with part ink at ~85% + Sulphur accents
illustration_medium.type: authored inline SVG gouge plates (woodcut-inspired, original art)

navigation.prev_next: quiet labeled buttons with chapter titles; Book IV next-button carries ladder tick
navigation.toc: part headers as book plates (Fraunces 900 roman numeral 2rem + mono subtitle, generous whitespace); chapter rows with mono numerals in part ink + Newsreader titles

II.body: NB. bars + blockquote edges in Bloodline
II.name: Critique of the Highest Values Hitherto

III.body: fragment numerals Verdigris; (a)/(b) sub-notes indented with green tick
III.name: Principle of a New Determination of Values

IV.body: opener rule becomes 3 ascending steps; next-button ladder tick
IV.motif: ladder / ascending steps to a star
IV.name: Discipline and Cultivation

signature_idea: The fragment as exhibit: gouged plate-mark chapter numerals + per-part woodcut motifs (ring / shattered tablet / lens-eye / ladder), one sulphur match-flame accent in an ink-black notebook.
title_swap_test: Swap in another Nietzsche title and the design lies: gouged fragment-numerals, NB. margin-cries, recurrence/tablet/eye/ladder plates and the bound-after-death apparatus belong to a fragment collection, not to polished aphorism-books.

conditions: W1: gouge TORN/irregular/knockout-violent; WtP goes rougher never cleaner (vs Sovereign intaglio, Churchill shards)
W2: Sulphur match-logic — small/hot/sparse, never large glowing fields
W3: authored fleuron indices + census; nth-child = automatic REVISE
W4: .reader-nb contract hook; body[data-chapter] fallback only with explicit per-chapter selector table
W5: tablet openers (p3c1/p4c1/p5c1) must read intentional not empty
W6: prototype scope = cover plate + 5 part plates + p1c1/p3c4/p3c10/p4c15/p5c3 openers + NB-heavy spread @ 3 viewports

chapter_endings.rule: authored per-part end-mark in part ink, declared per chapter in cohort JSON; never shared default, never modulo-chosen

benchmark_addendum.header: part + chapter in Plex Mono, part numeral in part ink; 1px Faint-Pencil rule with 24px Sulphur position segment
benchmark_addendum.prev_next: mono PREVIOUS/NEXT FRAGMENT-BOOK eyebrows in ADJACENT chapter part ink; Newsreader titles; Sulphur hairline on travel side; Book IV next-card ladder tick
benchmark_addendum.progress_resume: thin Sulphur bar with gouge-textured leading edge; cover Continue in Plex Mono with part-ink numeral + Sulphur arrow
benchmark_addendum.settings: mono labels, Sulphur selected states, part-ink neutral (book-chrome, not content)
benchmark_addendum.source: .omp/design/USER-FEEDBACK.md — homepage creativity bar expressed through each book's own identity
benchmark_addendum.toc_filter: mono SEARCH THE FRAGMENTS placeholder, Sulphur caret; Sulphur progress line; current = margin bar + part-ink numeral
benchmark_addendum.translator_numerals: 201 paragraphs carry inline edition numerals: superscript Plex Mono Ash 0.72em, no Sulphur, no links; no notes apparatus exists (notes_part null, zero note_refs/epigraph keys)
